stops.title: What a capability is
stops.caption: The thing a grant actually confers.
stops.speech: A grant is a bundle of capabilities. A capability is the single thing it lets you do, like reading a branch or writing to a department.

stops.title: Where they bite
stops.caption: Every page checks them.
stops.speech: Every page and every action checks a capability, which is why two people with different grants see genuinely different screens.
